transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We're here for the readiness review before we finalize the launch plan for the real-time collaboration service going to production Monday at 09:00 UTC. The draft plan has a 10% rollout, 10,000 concurrent connection cap, 5-second retry interval, primary region storage, and 90-day transcript retention. I'd like to go around the room for final sign-off from each area — backend engineering, reliability, privacy, and customer success. Who wants to start?

transcript.text: I need to flag something before we finalize. The rollout policy should set the retry interval to exactly 30 seconds. I haven't filed the client-library ticket yet, but this is critical for launch.
